newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's de Michelis faces embezzlement trial.
newsitem.headline: Italy's de Michelis faces embezzlement trial.

text.p: A Italian court has ordered disgraced former foreign minster Gianni de Michelis to stand trial for allegedly embezzling ministry funds.

The flamboyant de Michelis, known for his love of disco dancing, has already been sentenced to four years in prison in a separate case for taking kickbacks in exchange for supporting motorway construction in the northeast Veneto region.

The Rome court ruled on Monday evening that Socialist de Michelis should stand trial with his former top aide Giuseppe Baldocci for alleged misuse of foreign ministry funds during his time in office in 1990-92.
Both men say they used the money, about 270 million lire ($162,000), for official banquets, accommodation costs, gifts and to reimburse experts and specialists helping the ministry.
The trial is due to start in December.
De Michelis is also on trial in another case for allegedly siphoning off cash, with others, from aid projects.
In that case, prosecutors allege de Michelis and other accused diverted to the Socialist party some of the millions of dollars in funds destined for Third World projects.
De Michelis has denied all charges against him.
